Reject CR.4-only routing. Ordinary de Rham–Witt complexes are a supplier, not the full geometric logarithmic purity, weak Lefschetz and p-adic weight/base-change package. G6 requires a single explicit extension owner after primary-provider checks.

Generic E2/L5 hypercovers do not supply all of this. The unverified optional alteration branch has been removed.
